The EMPRESS Research Network is governed by three bodies &mdash; the Steering Committee, the Coordinating Committee, and the Data Safety Monitoring Board (DSMB) &mdash; supported by a project manager.

## Steering Committee {#steering}

**Responsibilities**: provide scientific direction; approve the protocol and important amendments; oversee overall study progress; make final decisions on key scientific issues (including sample size re-estimation and blinded data reviews).

**Domestic**

- **Xiaobo Huang** (Sichuan Provincial People's Hospital) &mdash; Director of the Department of Critical Care Medicine; long-standing clinical and research leader in critical care
- **Chun Pan** (Sichuan Provincial People's Hospital) &mdash; core member of the EMPRESS team focusing on severe infection and septic shock
- **Jingchao Luo** (Sichuan Provincial People's Hospital) &mdash; co-first author of the EMPRESS protocol
- **Mei Meng** (Shanghai Ninth People's Hospital) &mdash; corresponding author of the EMPRESS protocol
- **Yongpo Jiang** (Taizhou Hospital)
- **Xi Guo** (Qilu Third Hospital)

**International**

- **Minghao Luo** (United Kingdom) &mdash; Nuffield Department of Population Health, University of Oxford, and Harefield Hospital Anaesthetic and Critical Care; co-first author of the EMPRESS protocol
- **Jean-Louis Teboul** (France &middot; Universit&eacute; Paris-Saclay) &mdash; authority on hemodynamic monitoring and septic shock resuscitation
- **Glenn Hern&aacute;ndez** (Chile &middot; Pontificia Universidad Cat&oacute;lica de Chile) &mdash; principal investigator of the ANDROMEDA-SHOCK trials
- **Miguel Ibarra-Estrada** (Mexico &middot; Universidad de Guadalajara) &mdash; principal investigator of a methylene blue RCT (Crit Care 2023), key prior evidence for EMPRESS
- **Eduardo Kattan** (Chile &middot; Pontificia Universidad Cat&oacute;lica de Chile) &mdash; core member of ANDROMEDA-SHOCK-2; member of the Latin American Intensive Care Network (LIVEN)

## Coordinating Committee {#coordinating}

**Responsibilities**: day-to-day coordination of the network and study centers; site initiation and training; monitoring of enrollment progress and data quality; liaison with ethics committees and regulatory authorities.

- **Jingchao Luo** (Sichuan Provincial People's Hospital)
- **Sen Lu** (Sichuan Provincial People's Hospital) &mdash; corresponding author of the EMPRESS protocol
- **Jian Song** (Shanghai Fourth People's Hospital)

## Project Manager {#project-management}

- **Zhaoying Li** (Sichuan Provincial People's Hospital) &mdash; project manager, responsible for day-to-day coordination and project management

## Data Safety Monitoring Board (DSMB) {#dsmb}

**Responsibilities**: independent of the study team, periodically review safety and efficacy data; assess benefit-risk against prespecified boundaries; advise the Steering Committee to continue, modify, or stop the study. Board members are not involved in study conduct.

- **Ignacio Martin-Loeches** (Ireland) &mdash; Chair; authority on severe infection and respiratory critical care, contributor to multiple international consensus statements
- **Longxiang Su** (Peking Union Medical College Hospital) &mdash; tissue perfusion monitoring and critical care informatics
- **Xiaobo Yang** (Union Hospital, Tongji Medical College, Huazhong University of Science and Technology, Wuhan) &mdash; sepsis and severe infection

## Participating Centers {#centers}

The EMPRESS study is conducted at more than 50 tertiary hospital centers across China (emergency, respiratory, medical, surgical, and other ICUs). The list of participating centers and contact information will be published here once confirmed by the Coordinating Committee.

- List of participating centers &mdash; to be announced
